## Advising

David advises doctoral and master's students in the Education Policy program, chairing dissertation committees on topics spanning teacher effectiveness, educator diversity, and education labor markets. He also regularly serves as a committee member for students in Public Policy and in Measurement, Statistics, and Evaluation.

Prospective students interested in teacher labor markets, causal inference in education, or educator diversity are welcome to reach out — see the [Contact](index.qmd) section on the home page.
